posts.text: Spoke with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio. India and the US will continue to work closely for global good. Our partnership is built on shared values and a vision for a better world.

posts.text: PM chaired the 51st PRAGATI meeting reviewing 7 major infrastructure projects worth over ₹76,500 crore across railways, power and road transport. Monitoring progress at scale — from seed to delivery.

posts.text: Congratulations to the people of Assam. UCC has been the BJP's resolve since the day of its foundation. After Uttarakhand and Gujarat, Assam too has passed the Uniform Civil Code Bill. We are committed to enshrining the principle of equality before the law in every part of the country.

posts.text: A denial is not an answer. Why are the Education Minister and CBSE unable to answer the four simple questions I have asked? The future of 18.5 lakh students has been put in jeopardy. They deserve the truth.
posts.caption: A denial is not an answer. Why are the Education Minister and CBSE unable to answer the four simple questions I have asked? The future of 18.5 lakh students has been put in jeopardy. They deserve the truth.

posts.text: The loss of lives in a tragic accident on the Betwa River in Hamirpur district is extremely heartbreaking. Have directed officials to intensify relief and rescue operations immediately.
posts.caption: The loss of lives in a tragic accident on the Betwa River in Hamirpur district is extremely heartbreaking. Have directed officials to intensify relief and rescue operations immediately.

posts.text: After NEET, CBSE Class 12, and SSC GD, reports of irregularities are now emerging in B.Tech examinations as well. What kind of government is this that cannot even conduct a single examination properly? The entire education system has been taken over by mafias.

posts.text: Interacted with FM Tsahkna of Estonia and European Commissioner for the Mediterranean Šuica at the Gymnich meeting in Cyprus. India-EU ties continue to deepen across every dimension. 🇮🇳🇪🇺

posts.text: The momentum on reforms has not come down at all. The reform express mentioned by PM Modi guides every aspect of the Finance Bill — reviewing every law, every regulation, decriminalizing onerous provisions, shifting toward soft-touch regulation. India is becoming more economically vibrant.
posts.caption: The momentum on reforms has not come down at all. posts.text: Adani Ports reports strong year-on-year cargo volume growth for April 2026. Increased container traffic, bulk cargo movement and demand across key trade routes reflect India's resilient infrastructure story. Building for the nation, one port at a time.
posts.caption: Adani Ports reports strong year-on-year cargo volume growth for April 2026. Increased container traffic, bulk cargo movement and demand across key trade routes reflect India's resilient infrastructure story. Building for the nation, one port at a time.

posts.text: Reliance is expanding into new sectors — power and telecommunications. Scrapping of old agreements has opened up new growth opportunities. We will build our nationwide broadband network in an asset-light, but partnership-heavy approach.
posts.caption: Reliance is expanding into new sectors — power and telecommunications. Scrapping of old agreements has opened up new growth opportunities. We will build our nationwide broadband network in an asset-light, but partnership-heavy approach.

posts.text: I don't believe in taking right decisions. I take decisions and then make them right. The power of a nation lies in the strength of its people and their unwavering spirit.
posts.caption: I don't believe in taking right decisions. I take decisions and then make them right. The power of a nation lies in the strength of its people and their unwavering spirit.

posts.text: Eid ul-Adha Mubarak to all. May this occasion deepen the spirit of brotherhood, harmony and compassion in our society. Praying for the well-being and prosperity of every citizen of this great nation.
posts.caption: Eid ul-Adha Mubarak to all. May this occasion deepen the spirit of brotherhood, harmony and compassion in our society. Praying for the well-being and prosperity of every citizen of this great nation.

posts.text: I will be meeting now, in the Situation Room, to make a final determination on the Iran deal. Iran must agree they will NEVER have a Nuclear Weapon or Bomb. The Strait of Hormuz must be immediately open. Ships caught due to our amazing Naval Blockade may start heading home! Say HELLO to your families from me, your favorite President!

posts.text: Important to keep pushing for Conservative values in opposition. Holding the government accountable on fiscal discipline, strong borders, and economic growth remains our mission. The work doesn't stop.
posts.caption: Important to keep pushing for Conservative values in opposition. Holding the government accountable on fiscal discipline, strong borders, and economic growth remains our mission. The work doesn't stop.

posts.text: Grateful for the overwhelming support in the Ohio Republican primary. This isn't about me — it's about restoring common sense governance to the great state of Ohio. Ready to serve on day one.
posts.caption: Grateful for the overwhelming support in the Ohio Republican primary. This isn't about me — it's about restoring common sense governance to the great state of Ohio. Ready to serve on day one.

posts.text: Honoring our veterans this Memorial Day week. Their sacrifices secured the freedoms we cherish. Grateful for every man and woman who served.
posts.caption: Honoring our veterans this Memorial Day week. Their sacrifices secured the freedoms we cherish. Grateful for every man and woman who served.

posts.text: The FBI will continue to root out corruption and hold bad actors accountable. Transparency and accountability — that's how we rebuild trust in our institutions.
posts.caption: The FBI will continue to root out corruption and hold bad actors accountable. Transparency and accountability — that's how we rebuild trust in our institutions.

posts.text: AI policy must keep pace with innovation while ensuring safety. America's competitive edge depends on getting this balance right. Working with brilliant teams to make that happen.
posts.caption: AI policy must keep pace with innovation while ensuring safety. America's competitive edge depends on getting this balance right. Working with brilliant teams to make that happen.

posts.text: Climate adaptation and digital infrastructure are two sides of the same development coin. The World Bank is scaling solutions that work for the most vulnerable nations. No country should be left behind.
posts.caption: Climate adaptation and digital infrastructure are two sides of the same development coin. The World Bank is scaling solutions that work for the most vulnerable nations. No country should be left behind.

posts.text: The challenges Europe now faces demand an even stronger partnership. This treaty with Poland is the biggest step forward in our defence and security relationship in a generation — confronting modern threats that may be less visible but no less dangerous.
posts.caption: The challenges Europe now faces demand an even stronger partnership. This treaty with Poland is the biggest step forward in our defence and security relationship in a generation — confronting modern threats that may be less visible but no less dangerous.

posts.text: Australia's future is in the Indo-Pacific. Strengthening our alliances, investing in defence capability, and deepening trade partnerships across the region. That's how we keep Australians safe and prosperous.
posts.caption: Australia's future is in the Indo-Pacific. Strengthening our alliances, investing in defence capability, and deepening trade partnerships across the region. That's how we keep Australians safe and prosperous.

posts.text: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting on keeping the Strait of Hormuz open. Europe must take responsibility for its own security. We are building the architecture for a safer, more sovereign continent.
posts.caption: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting on keeping the Strait of Hormuz open. Europe must take responsibility for its own security. We are building the architecture for a safer, more sovereign continent.

posts.text: Dubai continues to lead by example — in innovation, tolerance and ambition. Our vision is clear: build a city and a nation that the world looks to for inspiration. The best is yet to come.
posts.caption: Dubai continues to lead by example — in innovation, tolerance and ambition. Our vision is clear: build a city and a nation that the world looks to for inspiration. The best is yet to come.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.
posts.caption: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.

posts.text: Proud of what Biohub has built — a world model of protein biology to accelerate drug discovery. We've verified the model's ability across immune diseases and cancer cases. Once released, others will quickly adopt them to tackle problems they see in the lab.
posts.caption: Proud of what Biohub has built — a world model of protein biology to accelerate drug discovery. We've verified the model's ability across immune diseases and cancer cases. Once released, others will quickly adopt them to tackle problems they see in the lab.

posts.text: AI is one of the deepest platform shifts we'll see in our lifetimes. At Google, we're investing in making it useful for everyone — from Search to Cloud to Android. The opportunity ahead is extraordinary.
posts.caption: AI is one of the deepest platform shifts we'll see in our lifetimes. At Google, we're investing in making it useful for everyone — from Search to Cloud to Android. The opportunity ahead is extraordinary.

posts.text: The rise of AI could lead to a bubble if its advantages are limited primarily to technology companies. The real unlock is when AI benefits every sector of the economy and every person in every role.
posts.caption: The rise of AI could lead to a bubble if its advantages are limited primarily to technology companies. The real unlock is when AI benefits every sector of the economy and every person in every role.

posts.text: A fixed cash payment, although useful and maybe a good idea in some ways, does not get at what we're really going to need for this phase. I'm much more interested in ways where we think about collective ownership. Everybody's got to participate in the upside.
posts.caption: A fixed cash payment, although useful and maybe a good idea in some ways, does not get at what we're really going to need for this phase. I'm much more interested in ways where we think about collective ownership. Everybody's got to participate in the upside.

posts.text: Chairing the Tsinghua University advisory board continues to be a privilege. Technology must serve people everywhere. Apple's commitment to innovation, privacy and accessibility remains unwavering.
posts.caption: Chairing the Tsinghua University advisory board continues to be a privilege. Technology must serve people everywhere. Apple's commitment to innovation, privacy and accessibility remains unwavering.

posts.text: Taiwan is the epicentre of the AI revolution. Four years ago we were spending $10-15 billion a year here. Now we're spending $100 billion, going to $150 billion in Taiwan each year. This is where the chips come, packaging comes, systems are made, AI supercomputers were created.
posts.caption: Taiwan is the epicentre of the AI revolution. Four years ago we were spending $10-15 billion a year here. Now we're spending $100 billion, going to $150 billion in Taiwan each year. This is where the chips come, packaging comes, systems are made, AI supercomputers were created.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure story is just getting started. From Aadhaar to UPI to ONDC — we're proving that technology designed for scale can transform a billion lives. The next wave is AI for governance.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure story is just getting started. From Aadhaar to UPI to ONDC — we're proving that technology designed for scale can transform a billion lives. The next wave is AI for governance.

posts.text: AI will be the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But the biggest gains will come from applying it to health, education and climate — not just making software companies more profitable.
posts.caption: AI will be the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But the biggest gains will come from applying it to health, education and climate — not just making software companies more profitable.

posts.text: Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production. At IBM, we're seeing clients deploy AI agents that handle real workflows — not demos, real business impact. The shift is happening faster than anyone predicted.
posts.caption: Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production. At IBM, we're seeing clients deploy AI agents that handle real workflows — not demos, real business impact. The shift is happening faster than anyone predicted.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they're multipliers. Adobe is putting generative AI into the hands of every creator, designer and marketer. The tools are getting more powerful, but the human vision remains irreplaceable.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they're multipliers. Adobe is putting generative AI into the hands of every creator, designer and marketer. The tools are getting more powerful, but the human vision remains irreplaceable.

posts.text: Building something new again. The best ideas come from the intersection of deep technology and genuine human need. Excited about what's ahead.
posts.caption: Building something new again. The best ideas come from the intersection of deep technology and genuine human need. Excited about what's ahead.

posts.text: Luxury is about craftsmanship, heritage and human connection. At Chanel, we're embracing innovation while staying true to what makes us timeless. Technology should amplify creativity, never replace it.
posts.caption: Luxury is about craftsmanship, heritage and human connection. At Chanel, we're embracing innovation while staying true to what makes us timeless. Technology should amplify creativity, never replace it.

posts.text: Global supply chains are being reshaped by AI, nearshoring and new trade corridors. At FedEx, we're investing in intelligent logistics that move faster, predict better and deliver smarter. The future of commerce is here.

posts.text: Into the final again! 💪🔥 What a night in Dharamsala. 557 runs this season and the IPL journey continues to be special. Surpassed 9,230 IPL runs — more than my entire Test career. Grateful for the team, the fans, and Anushka cheering from the stands. RCB forever. 🏏❤️
